title: Distinct roles of the two BRCA2 DNA binding domains in DNA damage repair and replication fork preservation
authors: Francisco Neal; Wenjing Li; Mollie E. Uhrig; Neelam Sharma; Shahrez Syed; Sandeep Burma; Robert Hromas; Alexander Mazin; Eloise Dray; David Libich; Shaun Olsen; Elizabeth Wasmuth; Weixing Zhao; Claus S. Sørensen; Claudia Wiese; Youngho Kwon; Patrick Sung
one_liner_zh: 该文通过遗传、生化与细胞实验解析BRCA2两个DNA结合域在损伤修复和复制叉维持中的不同作用，虽涉及蛋白-DNA互作但无AI或物理模拟方法，属于广义蛋白-DNA互作研究，对本课题有背景参考价值。
abstract: Homologous recombination (HR) is a highly conserved tool for the removal of DNA double-strand breaks (DSBs) and the preservation of stalled and damaged DNA replication forks. Successful completion of HR requires the tumor suppressor BRCA2. Germline mutations in BRCA2 lead to familial breast, ovarian, and other cancers, underscoring the importance of this protein for maintaining genome stability. BRCA2 harbors two distinct DNA binding domains, one that possesses three oligonucleotide/oligosaccharide binding (OB) folds (known as the OB-DBD), and with the other residing in the C-terminal recombinase binding domain (termed the CTRB-DBD) encoded by the last gene exon. Here, we employ a combination of genetic, biochemical, and cellular approaches to delineate contributions of these two DNA binding domains toward HR and the maintenance of stressed DNA replication forks. We show that OB-DBD and CTRB-DBD confer ssDNA and dsDNA binding capabilities to BRCA2, respectively, and that BRCA2 variants mutated in either DNA binding domain are impaired in the ability to load the recombinase RAD51 onto ssDNA pre-occupied by RPA. While the CTRB-DBD mutant is modestly affected for HR, it exhibits a strong defect in the protection of stressed replication forks. In contrast, the OB-DBD is indispensable for both BRCA2 functions. Our study thus defines the unique contributions of the two BRCA2 DNA binding domains in genome maintenance.
abstract_zh: 同源重组（homologous recombination, HR）是去除DNA双链断裂（double-strand breaks, DSBs）并维持停滞及受损DNA复制叉的高度保守工具。HR的成功完成需要肿瘤抑制因子BRCA2。BRCA2的种系突变导致家族性乳腺癌、卵巢癌及其他癌症，凸显了该蛋白在维持基因组稳定性中的重要性。BRCA2包含两个不同的DNA结合结构域，一个具有三个寡核苷酸/寡糖结合（OB）折叠（称为OB-DBD），另一个位于C端重组酶结合结构域（称为CTRB-DBD），由最后一个基因外显子编码。在此，我们结合遗传学、生物化学和细胞学方法，来阐明这两个DNA结合结构域在HR及维持应激DNA复制叉中的贡献。我们显示，OB-DBD和CTRB-DBD分别赋予BRCA2单链DNA和双链DNA结合能力，且任一DNA结合结构域突变的BRCA2变体在将重组酶RAD51加载到被RPA占据的单链DNA上的能力受损。尽管CTRB-DBD突变体对HR的影响较小，但它在保护应激复制叉方面表现出明显缺陷。相反，OB-DBD对BRCA2的两种功能均不可或缺。因此，我们的研究定义了BRCA2两个DNA结合结构域在基因组维持中的独特贡献。
